exposure: Socioeconomic trajectories from birth to adulthood
cohort: The study cohort consisted of children born in 2004 to 156 mothers and 110 fathers who were themselves part of 1982 population-based birth cohorts in Pelotas, Brazil.
finding: Strong effects of early poverty on gestational age and birth size were observed in the next generation among mothers, but not among fathers, suggesting a specific maternal effect of socioeconomic trajectory.
